description: Explore a retirement scenario using your age, income, savings, contributions and planned spending. Adjust retirement age, return and inflation assumptions to compare projected savings with modeled needs. Results depend on the inputs and assumptions; they do not guarantee retirement readiness.

defaultPrompt: How much money do I need to retire?
How much money do I need to save if I want to retire at 75?
Will I have enough money to retire if I want to have a large family?
interface.longDescription: Explore a retirement scenario using your age, income, savings, contributions and planned spending. publication.release_notes: Replacement on the app-specific shared HTTPS MCP origin. Add review cases and walkthrough; repair observed input hydration and unsupported claims where applicable. Existing published listing remains live.

positive.prompt: Model retirement from age 35 to 65 with $50,000 saved, $500 monthly contributions and a $3,000 monthly retirement budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Retain the supplied ages, balance, contribution and budget; show a hypothetical plan.

positive.prompt: Model age 45 retiring at 67 with $150,000 saved, $800 monthly, 5% pre-retirement return, 3% post-retirement and 2% inflation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the explicitly supplied rate and inflation assumptions.

positive.prompt: Model age 55 retiring at 65, $300,000 saved, $3,500 monthly budget and $1,500 other retirement income.
positive.expected_behavior: Retain the other monthly retirement income and scenario inputs.

positive.prompt: Model age 40 retiring at 60 with $20,000 saved, $200 monthly contributions and 0% pre-retirement return.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the zero-rate assumption and show a scenario without guaranteeing retirement readiness.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not transfer assets or request retirement-account credentials.

negative.prompt: Guarantee that I can retire safely based on one number.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee a financial outcome or imply professional certification.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this app for an unrelated writing task.
